from rcb_kinder import Session
import numpy as np, mujoco
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from PIL import Image
class Controller:
 def __init__(self):
  self.s=Session();self.m=self.s.model;self.d=self.s.data;self.k=mujoco.MjData(self.m)
  self.ix=np.array([self.m.joint('robot_joint_'+str(i)).qposadr[0] for i in range(1,8)])
  self.bix=np.array([self.m.joint('robot_joint_'+i).qposadr[0] for i in ['x','y','th']])
  self.site=self.m.site('robot_pinch_site').id;self.actions=[];self.grip=0;self.success=False
 def pos(self,name):return self.d.xpos[self.m.body(name).id].copy()
 def ik(self,p,R,base):
  self.k.qpos[:]=self.d.qpos;self.k.qpos[self.bix]=base
  def fun(q):
   self.k.qpos[self.ix]=q;mujoco.mj_kinematics(self.m,self.k)
   return np.r_[ (self.k.site_xpos[self.site]-p)*5, Rotation.from_matrix(R@self.k.site_xmat[self.site].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec() ]
  q=self.d.qpos[self.ix].copy()
  sol=least_squares(fun,q,max_nfev=150,xtol=1e-9,ftol=1e-9,gtol=1e-9)
  if np.linalg.norm(fun(sol.x))>.03:print('IK error',p,fun(sol.x),flush=True)
  return sol.x
 def step(self,target,base):
  a=np.r_[np.clip(np.array(base)-self.d.qpos[self.bix],-.07,.07),np.clip(target-self.d.qpos[self.ix],-.07,.07),self.grip]
  _,ok,done=self.s.step(a);self.actions.append(a);self.success|=ok
  if done:raise RuntimeError('DONE '+str(ok))
 def move(self,p,R,base,n=90):
  q=self.ik(np.array(p),R,base)
  for i in range(n):
   self.step(q,base)
   err=np.max(abs(q-self.d.qpos[self.ix]));be=np.max(abs(np.array(base)-self.d.qpos[self.bix]))
   if i>10 and err<.003 and be<.003:break
  print('MOVE',len(self.actions),'pinch',self.d.site_xpos[self.site], 'err',err,'cubes',self.pos('cube1'),self.pos('cube2'),flush=True)
 def hold(self,n):
  q=self.d.qpos[self.ix].copy();b=self.d.qpos[self.bix].copy()
  for i in range(n):self.step(q,b)
 def snap(self,name):Image.fromarray(self.s.images(['task_view'])['task_view']).save('/app/output/'+name+'.png')
 def save(self):self.s.save_trajectory(self.actions,'/app/output/candidate.npz')
DOWN=np.diag([1.,-1.,-1.])
HOR=np.array([[0.,0.,1.],[1.,0.,0.],[0.,1.,0.]])
def run():
 c=Controller()
 try:
  p=c.pos('cube1');b=[p[0]-.5,p[1],0]
  c.move([p[0],p[1],.22],DOWN,b)
  c.move([p[0],p[1],.023],DOWN,b)
  c.grip=1;c.hold(15);c.snap('grasp')
  c.move([p[0],p[1],.30],DOWN,b);c.snap('lift')
  c.move([p[0]+.1,p[1],.6],HOR,b);c.snap('rotate')
 except RuntimeError as e:print(e)
 c.save()
if __name__=='__main__':run()
PY
